sources.title: Rebels in the Pros: NFL Cut Day casualties
sources.description: There are always two sides to every coin. While we celebrate our former Rebels who made the 53 man rosters, there are those that found themselves on the outside looking in. Many will land on practice squads keeping the dream in reach, while others may even get claimed (Kapena Gushiken). This list is still changing […]
